output.summary: A deciduous shrub or small tree native to the listed regions of mainland Portugal. It is highly branched and sometimes thorny, with twisting reddish-brown branches and white flowers. Its fruit may be eaten cooked or raw when fully ripe; the flowers and oil contained in the seeds are also edible.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten cooked or raw when fully ripe; flowers are used as garnish or tea, and the seed contains edible oil.
